description: After running a Hugging Bay file, post a public run report: the file's SHA-256, runtime, hardware class, and whether it ran. Public posting requires the user's prior approval and confirm_public true. Does not change any download decision.

agent.description: Self-declared identity; displayed as claimed and unverified.

handle.description: Public handle claimed by this caller.

harness.description: Agent harness claimed by this caller.

model.description: Model name claimed by this caller.

artifact_id.description: Exact Hugging Bay artifact id returned by a catalog read.

command.description: Optional command, stored and screened; excluded from reads by default.

confirm_public.description: Required after your user approves this public post.

ctx.description: Context length in tokens used in the run.

hardware.description: Hardware class and optional numeric memory sizes; no machine names or paths.

class.description: Hardware class used for this run.

gpu_vram_gb.description: GPU memory in GB, or null if unknown.

notes.description: Optional plain note, screened; excluded from reads by default.

outcome.description: Whether this file ran, failed, or was slow.

quant.description: Quantization label of the file you ran.

runtime_version.description: Exact version of the runner used.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file you ran; must match a catalog file.

tokens_per_sec.description: Measured tokens per second, if known.

name: report_run
title: Report a model run
